body.statement: Fix \(\eta\in\mathcal C(\mathcal O)\) and an admissible \(B\) in the sense of the graphical replacement lemma. Does the replacement graphical specification admit finite-alphabet shared-response-function kernels with positive selection probability and non-target kernel stability such that every pooled selected law \(P_{\widetilde\eta,k}^{\mathrm{pool}}\), \(k\in[K]\), is faithful to its replacement MAG? For any supplied finite-dimensional rational parameterization satisfying the Markov direction, this existence question reduces to atomic determinant nontriviality: for every \(k\in[K]\) and every conditional-independence query that is \(m\)-connected in the replacement MAG, at least one cleared conditional-independence determinant must be a nonzero polynomial on the equality-constrained shared-response-function parameter space. The finite-union exceptional-set argument is valid once these atomic certificates are available; the atomic certificates themselves remain open.
body.justification: The node is now the explicit faithful-realization question, supported by a proved algebraic exceptional-set reduction.
body.gap: Atomic determinant nontriviality on the equality-constrained shared-response-function twin space remains open.
body.consumer: An affirmative answer would promote graphical replacement specifications to faithful whole-family witnesses.

obligation.what_is_open: For every admissible replacement twin family and every query that is m-connected in its replacement MAG, exhibit an admissible equality-constrained shared-response-function parameter at which at least one conditional-independence determinant is nonzero.
obligation.obstruction: Unrestricted multinomial-DAG generic faithfulness does not imply nontriviality after the shared-response-function equalities, basal-event conditioning, and fixed pooled weight are imposed; the core does not specify a cross-world coupling that supplies the needed atomic witness.
obligation.attempted: Reduced all simultaneous unfaithfulness events to finitely many determinant polynomials, proved the finite-union product argument on a nonempty open parameter set, and verified that positive local tables satisfy factorization, stability, and selection positivity. The reduction stops exactly at atomic determinant nontriviality.
obligation.partial_result: For any supplied nonempty open rational parameterization of the equality-constrained shared-response-function family, conditional independence is equivalent to finitely many cleared determinant-polynomial equations. If every \(m\)-connected query has one determinant polynomial that is not identically zero, the product of one such polynomial per query is nonzero and therefore is nonzero at some common parameter point; all pooled selected laws are then faithful simultaneously. Conversely, any simultaneously faithful point certifies nontriviality for every \(m\)-connected query. Positive local tables already satisfy factorization, non-target stability, and positive selection. Only the atomic nontriviality certificates on the constrained twin space remain unproved.
